token_contract.note: Recipes compile from Atlas signature tokens. They do not assert market demand, funding intent, eligibility, contactability or authority.

FUND_THESIS.purpose: Find investors or strategic capital providers whose published thesis overlaps the Atlas signature.

CURRENT_CALL.purpose: Find currently published calls, programmes, grants, sponsorships, prizes or accelerators.

HISTORICAL_AWARD.purpose: Find historical awards as evidence of prior funding behaviour, never future intent.

PORTFOLIO_SIMILARITY.purpose: Find organisations that publicly backed adjacent products, organisations or work domains.

PROGRAMME_ELIGIBILITY.purpose: Locate published eligibility criteria for a discovered programme.

FOUNDATION_MISSION.purpose: Find foundations and philanthropic organisations by published mission overlap.

IMPACT_PORTFOLIO.purpose: Find published programme and impact portfolios related to Atlas themes.

PUBLIC_ROUTE.purpose: Find an explicit public application or contact route without synthesizing personal contact data.

PUBLIC_ROLE.purpose: Find publicly documented professional roles relevant to a target organisation.
queries: site:{canonical_domain} team programme officer investment partner

RECENT_FUND_SIGNAL.purpose: Find recent public signals about deployment, new funds, programmes or strategic priorities.

ADJACENT_DOMAIN.purpose: Expand discovery into Atlas-adjacent domains while remaining bounded by the discovery budget.

INNOVATION_PROGRAMME.purpose: Find innovation programmes related to the Atlas domain signature.

PATRONAGE_PROGRAMME.purpose: Find public patronage, membership or sponsorship mechanisms aligned with open/public-benefit work.

ACCESSIBILITY_GRANT.purpose: Find accessibility and digital-inclusion funding calls.

ACCELERATOR_CALL.purpose: Find active accelerator calls aligned to the Atlas signature.

INNOVATION_PRIZE.purpose: Find active innovation prizes and challenge competitions.
